name: sub2api
description: Sub2API 一站式开源中转服务，让 Claude、Openai 、Gemini、Grok订阅统一接入，支持拼车共享，更高效分摊成本，原生工具无缝使用。

capability_evidence.multi-agent-orchestration: targets and bridged to xAI HTTP/SSE Responses upstream
capability_evidence.model-routing: .ai/v1 default are redirected to the subscription proxy at runtime.
capability_evidence.billing-metering: tform designed to distribute and manage API quotas from AI product subscriptions.

friction.note_en: Some setup. install via curl | sh installer, global npm install; needs docker compose up, git clone (build from source); configure environment variables, API key configuration; one-click setup
friction.note_zh: 需要一些配置。可通过 curl | sh installer、global npm install 安装；需要 docker compose up、git clone (build from source)；需配置 environment variables、API key configuration；one-click setup

analysis.summary_en: AI API Gateway Platform for Subscription Quota Distribution
highlights: Public Responses targets: /v1/responses, /responses, and /backend-api/codex/responses, forwarded to the Grok subscription proxy for OAuth accounts or https://api.x.ai/v1/responses for API-k…
Rate Limiting - Configurable request and token rate limits
Multi-Account Management - Support multiple upstream account types (OAuth, API Key)
API Key Distribution - Generate and manage API Keys for users
analysis.summary_zh_native: AI API 网关平台 - 订阅配额分发管理
highlights_zh: 多账号管理 - 支持多种上游账号类型（OAuth、API Key）
内置支付系统 - 支持 EasyPay 易支付、支付宝官方、微信官方、Stripe，用户自助充值，无需独立部署支付服务（配置指南）
外部系统集成 - 支持通过 iframe 嵌入外部系统（如工单等），扩展管理后台功能
API Key 分发 - 为用户生成和管理 API Key

discovery.seed_reason: Turn upstream AI subscriptions into a metered, rate-limited, billable relay.
